title: Roger Goodell: NFL will make announcement on Jed York when investigation is completed

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Roger Goodell: NFL will make announcement on Jed York when investigation is completed
sources.description: An appearance by Commissioner Roger Goodell on the Netflix pregame show in advance of 49ers-Rams in Melbourne included a box-checking question about the no-contest plea by 49ers owner Jed York on a pair of misdemeanor charges arising from a prostitution-related arrest last month.
